newsitem.title: JAPAN: TEPCO to provide technical aid to Taiwan on ABWR.
newsitem.headline: TEPCO to provide technical aid to Taiwan on ABWR.

text.p: Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc (TEPCO) said on Friday it will provide technical assistance to Taiwan Power Co (Taipower) on the construction of advanced boiling water reactors (ABWR).

TEPCO, together with General Electric Co (GE), Hitachi Ltd and Toshiba Corp, developed ABWR technology, and brought the world"s first unit on line last year at its Kashiwazaki-Kariba nuclear power plant in northern Japan.
Taipower last year awarded a contract to build two ABWRs to a GE-led consortium which included Hitachi and Toshiba.
The Japanese power firm tentatively plans to hold a week-long seminar on construction technology for Taipower, but details of the seminar have not been decided, a TEPCO spokeswoman said.
She also said TEPCO is ready to provide Taipower with further technical know-how on the operations and maintenance of ABWRs if the Taiwanese side asks for it.
